title: Prototyping ⚔️CHEST HERO 🪙, a small Idle Clicker!
author: AntiqueFeedback7447
selftext:
Implementing game juice, 3d assets and vfx with r/ClaudeAI Fable 5 in r/threejs feels way smoother! UI is still a bit of a pain and needs lots of guidance but its getting there!

Mostly using a toon material and toon ui style with imperfect outlines to give it a more playful look!

Play the early demo here: [https://chesthero.vercel.app/](https://chesthero.vercel.app/)

comments.author: IdleLegends
comments.body:
Hey, I have a prototyping section on my website you could host this in. Users can request access or you can set a password for people to try it and comment. 

[MythosArcade.com](http://MythosArcade.com)

comments.author: Desperate-Storm-7085
comments.body: The assets are so good! How long did this take? it seems polished!

replies.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
replies.body: Thank you! Started monday afternoon, so roughly ~3.5 days up to this current state :)

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: cute. is this for mobile then? I think you nail the gameplay and the visuals. good job

replies.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
replies.body: Thanks! Yeah mobile would be the goal :)

comments.author: Abhinik
comments.body: How did you create those assets? The characters and animations?

replies.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
replies.body: All generated with Fable in Three.js. Characters are mostly a composition of primitive shapes, with a toon material and toon outline that looks slightly imperfect to give it a more playful look :)

comments.author: darthbiki
comments.body:
Holding down the mouse button should count as clicking - I think most games do that nowadays. Also hovering over coins should be enough to pick them up.

Nice progress so far!

replies.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
replies.body: Thank you for the valid feedback! Will look into it :)
